game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Camel Trail, a camel trail: the oasis keeper must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Algorithm Race: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process.
theme: Sand Dunes – Camel Trail: a camel trail
core_gameplay_loop: In Camel Trail, repeat each round: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process. Each round, scarab swarms strike the caravan wagon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the speed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the caravan wagon from scarab swarms in Camel Trail: keep the speed meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: speed drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 43-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Algorithm Race
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Algorithm Race' (Week 9 slot 12), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Camel Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how speed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against scarab swarms in Camel Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 43 seconds while speed > 0.
